name: GeForce RTX 5070 Twin Edge OC
description: The GeForce RTX 5070 Twin Edge OC pairs 12GB of GDDR7 memory with a dual-fan cooler in a compact 2.5-slot design. PCI Express 5.0 connectivity and support for ray tracing and DLSS make it a graphics card for modern gaming and creative builds.
specifications: Graphics features: Ray tracing and DLSS support
imageAlt: Graphics card and PC components on a desk

name: AeroBook 14 Creator Edition
description: The AeroBook 14 Creator Edition combines an Intel Core Ultra 7 processor with 16GB of memory and a 1TB NVMe SSD. Its 14-inch high-resolution display and portable format suit creative work, study, and everyday computing.
imageAlt: Slim laptop open on a wooden desk

name: Studio One Wireless Headphones
description: Studio One wireless headphones combine active noise cancellation with up to 40 hours of battery life. The foldable over-ear design and Bluetooth connection make them easy to carry between work, travel, and home listening.

name: Arc 27 QHD Monitor
description: The Arc 27 pairs a 27-inch QHD IPS panel with a 180Hz refresh rate and a 1ms response time. Adaptive sync support helps keep motion smooth, while the 1440p resolution gives games and desktop work more room for detail.
imageAlt: Modern widescreen monitor on a clean desk

name: Keychron K2 Pro Mechanical Keyboard
description: The Keychron K2 Pro uses a compact 75% layout to keep the essential keys while freeing desk space. Hot-swappable switches let you customize the typing feel, and Bluetooth or USB-C connectivity supports flexible setups across Mac and Windows.
specifications: Compatibility: Mac and Windows keycaps included
imageAlt: Compact mechanical keyboard with dark keycaps

name: Vortex Airflow Mid-Tower Case
description: The Vortex Airflow is a mid-tower case with ATX motherboard support, a mesh front panel, and four included ARGB fans. A tempered-glass side panel shows off the build, while the airflow-focused front helps move air through the system.
specifications: Form factor: Mid-tower with ATX support
imageAlt: Custom desktop PC with illuminated components

name: Pulse Wireless Mouse
description: The Pulse wireless mouse combines a 59g lightweight shell with a 26,000 DPI optical sensor for responsive pointer control. Its battery lasts up to 70 hours, and USB-C charging keeps it ready for work or play.

name: Corsair RM850e 850W Power Supply
description: The Corsair RM850e supplies 850W of continuous power and carries 80 PLUS Gold certification. Its fully modular cables help simplify cable routing, and ATX 3.1 plus PCIe 5.1 readiness support current PC build requirements.

name: Ryzen 7 9800X3D Desktop Processor
description: The Ryzen 7 9800X3D is an 8-core, 16-thread desktop processor for the AM5 platform. It boosts up to 5.2GHz and uses AMD 3D V-Cache technology, making it a strong choice for gaming-focused systems and demanding desktop workloads.

name: Soundstage Desktop Speakers
description: Soundstage is a compact 2.0 stereo speaker pair for a desktop setup. USB-C and Bluetooth inputs provide wired and wireless connection options, with front-facing volume control for quick adjustments.

name: MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk Motherboard
description: The MSI MAG B650 Tomahawk is an ATX motherboard for AMD AM5 processors, built on the B650 chipset. It supports DDR5 memory, PCIe 4.0, and Wi-Fi 6E for a current-generation desktop build.
imageAlt: Motherboard with heatsinks and component slots

name: Kingston FURY Beast DDR5 32GB Kit
description: This Kingston FURY Beast kit provides 32GB of DDR5 memory across two 16GB modules. It is rated for 6000MT/s and includes Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO profiles for supported desktop platforms.
specifications: Profiles: Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO
imageAlt: Desktop memory modules on a dark surface

name: Kingston NV3 1TB NVMe SSD
description: The Kingston NV3 provides 1TB of NVMe storage in an M.2 2280 form factor. Its PCIe 4.0 interface and rated read speeds up to 6000MB/s make it a compact storage option for compatible laptops and desktop systems.

name: GeForce RTX 3060 12GB (Used)
description: A pre-loved GeForce RTX 3060 with 12GB of GDDR6 memory. Fully tested, cleaned, and repasted by our technicians. Ideal for 1080p gaming builds on a budget. Ships with a 7-day check warranty.
imageAlt: Used graphics card on a workbench

name: ThinkPad T14 Gen 2 (Used)
description: A business-grade ThinkPad T14 in Grade A condition with an Intel Core i7 processor, 16GB of memory, and a fast 512GB SSD. Battery health verified above 80%. Ships with a 7-day check warranty.
